data.name: st.subtitle
data.value: Ticket numbering, defaults, behavior rules, autoresponses and agent alerts.

data.name: st.efEnableHelp
data.value: Agents can send effort proposals on tickets; the user approves or rejects with a note from the portal.

data.name: st.efBlockWorkHelp
data.value: A ticket cannot be moved to 'in progress' until the effort is approved.

data.name: st.efRejectNoteHelp
data.value: Users must write an explanatory note when rejecting a proposal.

data.name: st.efReminderHelp
data.value: If a proposal stays unanswered this many days, the user gets a reminder.

data.name: st.efAutoApproveHelp
data.value: Proposals under this value are approved automatically; 0 = off.

data.name: st.efRevLimitHelp
data.value: At most this many proposals can be sent for one ticket.

data.name: st.arEffortHelp
data.value: When a new effort proposal is sent, the user receives an email with an approval link.

data.name: st.numberFormatHelp
data.value: # marks are replaced with random/sequential digits. Example: R716555

data.name: st.sequenceHelp
data.value: Random numbers are unguessable; sequential ones advance from a counter.

data.name: st.dlgSeqHelp
data.value: Sequential counters are defined here; each format can use its own counter.

data.name: st.defStatusHelp
data.value: New tickets open in this status.

data.name: st.defPriorityHelp
data.value: Used when no help topic or form sets a priority.

data.name: st.defSlaHelp
data.value: The plan applied when no department or help topic assigns an SLA.

data.name: st.defTopicHelp
data.value: Applied to email-created tickets when no topic was chosen.

data.name: st.defQueueHelp
data.value: The agent panel opens ticket lists with this queue.

data.name: st.topCountsHelp
data.value: Shows per-queue ticket counts in the side menu; turning it off improves performance on large installs.

data.name: st.lockHelp
data.value: Prevents two agents replying to the same ticket at once.

data.name: st.maxOpenHelp
data.value: 0 = unlimited. Over the limit, new tickets are rejected and a notice can be sent.

data.name: st.captchaHelp
data.value: Visitors who are not signed in pass a robot check when opening a ticket.

data.name: st.claimOnResponseHelp
data.value: An agent replying to an unassigned ticket automatically claims it.

data.name: st.autoReferOnCloseHelp
data.value: The closing agent is added as a referrer so they hear about reopenings.

data.name: st.requireTopicToCloseHelp
data.value: Tickets without a help topic cannot be closed; reports stay consistent.

data.name: st.externalImagesHelp
data.value: Remote images in emails are displayed in threads. Keep off for privacy.

data.name: st.collabVisibilityHelp
data.value: People added as participants can view the ticket on the user portal.

data.name: st.attachNote
data.value: Attachment rules (allowed types, count, size) are configured on the Attachments field of the Ticket Details form:

data.name: st.arNewTicketHelp
data.value: A confirmation email is sent to the user when a ticket is opened.

data.name: st.arAgentNewHelp
data.value: The user is notified when an agent opens a ticket on their behalf.

data.name: st.arNewMessageHelp
data.value: A 'received' confirmation is sent for every user message.

data.name: st.arNewMessageCollabHelp
data.value: Copies of new messages are forwarded to ticket participants.

data.name: st.arOverlimitHelp
data.value: Users exceeding the open-ticket limit receive an explanatory email.

data.name: st.alNewTicketHelp
data.value: Sent when a new ticket arrives in the system.

data.name: st.alNewMessageHelp
data.value: Sent when a user replies to an existing ticket.

data.name: st.alNewActivityHelp
data.value: Sent when an internal note or agent activity is added.

data.name: st.alAssignmentHelp
data.value: Sent when a ticket is assigned to an agent or team.

data.name: st.alTransferHelp
data.value: Sent when a ticket is transferred to another department.

data.name: st.alEffortHelp
data.value: Sent when the user approves or rejects an effort proposal.

data.name: st.alOverdueHelp
data.value: Sent when a ticket passes its SLA and becomes overdue.

data.name: st.alSystemErrorsHelp
data.value: Critical system problems are emailed to the administrator.

data.name: st.queuesHelp
data.value: Queues define the ticket lists in the agent panel. Use the builder to edit criteria, columns and sorting.

data.name: st.errFormat
data.value: The number format must contain at least one # mark.

data.name: st.errValues
data.value: Some fields are invalid; nothing was saved.

data.name: st.errSeqInUse
data.value: A sequence that is in use or system-protected cannot be deleted.

data.name: st.errSeqNext
data.value: The next value cannot move backwards; it must stay above the highest used number.
